description: /security slot 0: a dark auto-advancing 4-item accordion beside a product screenshot. `hasDecoration:false` on this page, so there is no ellipse and no dune — the only decoration is a pair of hard-coded overlay layers in the component.

provenance.note: Provenance of this asset in the page being specified. `generated` is FORBIDDEN for any assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-not-fabricate-real-brand or must-not-fabricate-compliance-claim, and for must-reuse-exact roles. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#ASSET_PROVENANCE_POLICY and schema/semantic_validate.py.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

asset.note: intrinsic 2328x1326 (ratio 1.7557) is load-bearing: there is no aspect-ratio wrapper, so the intrinsic ratio sets the image height

panelOpacity.note: snaps at height-end, does not tween

progressBar.driver: WAAPI, no CSS easing on the element

knownUpstreamDefects: A stray `hello` class sits on each item’s bottom bracket.
copyBudgetDerivation: Each maxWords budget is max(measured+2, ceil(measured*1.25)). The measured maxima were computed by importing the real src/data/*.js modules and word-counting every string for that field across every route. See extraction/measured-values.json#copyBudgets.
